description: For every old relation symbol \(R\), including arity zero, the specified quotient satisfies \(R^{Q_N}(q\circ\bar a)\leftrightarrow R^N(\bar a)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.quotient_relation.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {N : Type z}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N) {n : ℕ} (R : L.Relations n) (a : Fin n → N) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap R (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h ∘ a) ↔
    FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap (Sum.inl R) a
